title: Root dethronement via version bump attack
description: Filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-n9ik.1. Authentication bypass allowing malicious nodes to dethrone DODAG root.
close_reason: Fixed: Added early guard in process_dio() to reject all DIOs when node is Root. Prevents version-bump dethronement attack where malicious nodes could send DIO(version+1) to trigger adopt_version() and transition root to Unjoined. Added regression test root_rejects_version_bump_dethronement_attack.
